question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Contaminate’ from the given sentence.

Crews were requested to purify the system since a brain-eating amoeba was discovered in the drinking water.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contaminate"** means to make something impure by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance. (प्रदूषित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Industrial waste can **contaminate** water sources, making them unsafe for drinking.
 
 
 
• **"Purify" **refers to the process of making something clean and free from contaminants. (शुद्ध करना)
 
 
• **Example: **To ensure safe drinking water, it is essential to** purify** it by removing harmful substances.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'contaminate' **is **'purify'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Requested** (अनुरोध किया): To ask for something politely or formally.

 
 
• **Example:** She** requested** extra time to complete the project.
 
 
 
• **Discovered** (खोजा): To find something or someone unexpectedly or during a search.
 
 
• **Example: **The scientist **discovered** a new species of plant.
 
 
 
• **System** (प्रणाली): A set of connected things or parts forming a complex whole.
 
 
• **Example:** The computer** system** needs an upgrade to function efficiently.
